summary: Phoenix proposal meets all the requirements and constraints, allowing local agents to exchange immutable snapshots and typed research signals continuously without mutating production weights, verdicts, or trades.
top_technical_reasons: Events can be appended and replayed deterministically.
Each event has an immutable hash chain and safety flags.
Agent Director can publish one snapshot and typed signals without changing its existing return contract.
Invalid or unsafe events are rejected.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Phoenix can handle high-volume event streams without compromising performance.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: To evaluate Phoenix's scalability and performance under heavy loads.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Phoenix can maintain data integrity and consistency across multiple agents.
next_experiments.change: Introduce multiple agents with varying event streams.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Data consistency and integrity across agents.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: To assess Phoenix's ability to maintain data integrity and consistency in a multi-agent environment.
